_doc: Kind -> type-table entry -> handler names for the ENG3 levels (L02/L07/L09 RE.02). See tools/level/eng3_types.py for the rules.

kinds.what: Hercules (hero, pool A slot 0); type entry is the stub, driven by HERO_Tick 0x174e0

bonus item; subtype = spawn byte +0xc: 0=golden helmet (bank 1 105-118): 0x3fae4=1, hero+0xec=200 ticks invulnerable, SFX 0x603e; 1=blue potion (120-135): health gs+0x24 += 0x20, capped at max gs+0x1e, SFX 0x603b; 2=large coin (bank 2 XTRA_DB1 17-38): gs+0x18 += 1, SFX 0x603f; 3=winged sandals (152-167): dash, hero+0xee=0x56, 0x3fb20=1, HUD 0x3fae8=1, SFX 0x602c; 4=small coin (bank 2 17-38, scale 0xc0): gs+0x14 += 1, SFX 0x603f; 5=urn (211-218): secret counter 0x3faec += 1 and gs+0x11 bit (GAUNTLET by track: 0->1, 1-2->2, 3-6->4, 7-10->8; CYCLOPS by count 1..4 -> 1/2/4/8; TORMENT track 0->1, 1-2->4, 3-4->8), SFX 0x603e; 6=amphora (250-257): lives gs+0xc += 1, 0x41c72=1, SFX 0x603d (spawn turns it into subtype 1 when lives > 8); 7=mini Hercules (310-313): max health gs+0x1e += 0x20 (0xff cap), SFX 0x603d; 8-15=letters H,E,R,C,U,L,E,S (bank 8 LETTERS, scripts 10-16, E twice): 0x41cb0 = 0..7, gs+0x1c |= 1<<n, 0x41d50=1, SFX 0x603c
kinds.gives: 0=golden helmet (bank 1 105-118): 0x3fae4=1, hero+0xec=200 ticks invulnerable, SFX 0x603e; 1=blue potion (120-135): health gs+0x24 += 0x20, capped at max gs+0x1e, SFX 0x603b; 2=large coin (bank 2 XTRA_DB1 17-38): gs+0x18 += 1, SFX 0x603f; 3=winged sandals (152-167): dash, hero+0xee=0x56, 0x3fb20=1, HUD 0x3fae8=1, SFX 0x602c; 4=small coin (bank 2 17-38, scale 0xc0): gs+0x14 += 1, SFX 0x603f; 5=urn (211-218): secret counter 0x3faec += 1 and gs+0x11 bit (GAUNTLET by track: 0->1, 1-2->2, 3-6->4, 7-10->8; CYCLOPS by count 1..4 -> 1/2/4/8; TORMENT track 0->1, 1-2->4, 3-4->8), SFX 0x603e; 6=amphora (250-257): lives gs+0xc += 1, 0x41c72=1, SFX 0x603d (spawn turns it into subtype 1 when lives > 8); 7=mini Hercules (310-313): max health gs+0x1e += 0x20 (0xff cap), SFX 0x603d; 8-15=letters H,E,R,C,U,L,E,S (bank 8 LETTERS, scripts 10-16, E twice): 0x41cb0 = 0..7, gs+0x1c |= 1<<n, 0x41d50=1, SFX 0x603c
